caption:
Africa holds 18% of global population but under 1% of data center capacity. That compute deficit is officially closing.

From a $1.2B Blackwell AI factory in Morocco to 7-exaflop deployments in South Africa, NVIDIA partners are pouring billions into local GPU infrastructure.

According to McKinsey, data center demand on the continent could reach 2.2 gigawatts by 2030—requiring up to $20B in construction.

Read the full breakdown slide-by-slide.

fact_check.claim: Africa has roughly 18% of global population but less than 1% of data center capacity.
Nexus AI factory in Morocco represents a $1.2B initial investment with 500MW planned using NVIDIA Blackwell.
Stratos Lab is deploying over 50 NVIDIA HGX B300 systems delivering over 7 exaflops of performance.
McKinsey estimates African data center demand will rise to 1.5–2.2 GW by 2030 requiring $10–$20B in construction.
